description: ResOpsUS+CARS extends ResOpsUS with hydrometeorological series and static reservoir, dam and catchment attributes. The CARAVAN-style structure supports cross-model comparison and a planned series of national datasets. This resource is provided by Casado Rodríguez, Jesús; Disperati, Juliana; Salamon, Peter. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: This extension is distinct from the underlying ResOpsUS observations; provenance and derived variables need retaining. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
